step3.ptxt: Start the engine, select "Diagnosis" → "System Diagnosis/Chassis" → "System Name/IPA" → "ECU Data Monitor" on SST (TaSCAN) and select the item to be inspected.

atten3.ptxt: ECU Data Monitor values vary greatly due to slight measurement errors, differences in measurement environment, changes in the vehicle over time, etc., making it difficult to indicate a clear standard (judgment value). Therefore, a malfunction may exist even if values are within the reference range.

table.title: [Diagnosis Menu Screen: Chassis → IPA → ECU Data Monitor]

entry.ptxt: Right wheel travel distance information (wheel speed pulses) displayed as a number from "0" to "255"
(Varies depending on tire size, inflation pressure and wear condition.)
Left wheel travel distance information (wheel speed pulses) displayed as a number from "0" to "255"
(Varies depending on tire size, inflation pressure and wear condition.)
FL Wheel Speed Sensor Power Supply
"Front left wheel speed sensor power supply voltage status is normal or possibly low" displayed as "Normal" or "Low"
Normal: Front LH wheel speed sensor power supply voltage normal
Low: Front LH wheel speed sensor power supply voltage low
FR Wheel Speed Sensor Power Supply
"Front right wheel speed sensor power supply voltage status is normal or possibly low" displayed as "Normal" or "Low"
Normal: Front RH wheel speed sensor power supply voltage normal
Low: Front RH wheel speed sensor power supply voltage low
"Front left wheel speed sensor signal status is normal or possibly open/short" displayed as "Normal" or "Open/Short"
Normal: Front LH wheel speed sensor signal normal
Open/Short: Front LH wheel speed sensor signal open or shorted
"Front right wheel speed sensor signal status is normal or possibly open/short" displayed as "Normal" or "Open/Short"
Normal: Front RH wheel speed sensor signal normal
Open/Short: Front RH wheel speed sensor signal open or shorted
"Communication status with power steering computer is normal or possibly abnormal" displayed as "Normal" or "Abnormal"
Number of DTCs displayed as a number from "0" to "255"
